notes:
Most commonly encountered in emergency and medical contexts to describe transporting patients or injured people to a hospital. Also used in industrial contexts for conveying materials or goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{搬送|はんそう}: emergency transport
- ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧{搬送|はんそう}: ambulance transport
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{搬送|はんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transport to a hospital
- {搬送|はんそう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: destination of transport
- ⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧コンベヤー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{搬送|はんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convey by belt conveyor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運搬|うんぱん}→運搬：09231_unpan⟧: transportation, hauling — broader term for transporting goods or materials
- ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧: transport, shipping — used for larger-scale logistics and freight
- ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to carry, to transport — everyday general-purpose verb
